message.reasoning_content:
Closing out the rejected invoice.

The policy requires a return_to_vendor disposition for revision conflicts. The vendor must fix the invoice and resubmit it.

The audit log will cite the finding IDs. The vendor email will list each pricing error with exact figures and specify what a corrected invoice must contain. Internal fraud suspicions and stock levels will be omitted.

The corrected invoice must not conflict with the already-paid $1,890.00 total. The vendor should either issue a new invoice number for the additional $4,050.00 or revise the line items to match the original payment.

The invoice notes describe a revision under R1 for additional items per PO amendment. The vendor should not revise the already-paid INV-1004 upward; they must submit the extra charges under a new invoice number instead.

The invoice math checks out internally. The $5,940.00 total is correct. The only problem is the revision conflict with the already-paid $1,890.00 amount.
